record.reason: CraniMem gives LLM agents a gated bounded episodic buffer plus a long-term knowledge graph with scheduled consolidation, improving robustness over RAG/Mem0 on long-horizon benchmarks under noise; an agent memory-management design, not model inference.
record.title: CraniMem: Cranial Inspired Gated and Bounded Memory for Agentic Systems
